mapper.sql: SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, g.Description, g.SortOrder, COUNT(s.StoryId) AS StoryCount FROM dbo.Genre g LEFT JOIN dbo.StoryGenre sg ON sg.GenreId = g.GenreId LEFT JOIN dbo.Story s ON s.StoryId = sg.StoryId AND s.IsDeleted = 0
mapper.select: GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, g.Description, g.SortOrder ORDER BY g.SortOrder, g.GenreId
WHERE g.GenreId = #{genreId} GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, g.Description, g.SortOrder
mapper.insert: INSERT dbo.Genre (Name, Slug, Description, SortOrder) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{description, jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.StoryGenre WHERE GenreId = #{genreId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

SELECT TagId, Name, Slug, UsageCount FROM dbo.Tag
ORDER BY UsageCount DESC, Name, TagId OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT TagId, Name, Slug, UsageCount FROM dbo.Tag WHERE TagId = #{tagId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.Tag SET Name = #{name}, Slug = #{slug} WHERE TagId = #{tagId}
mapper.select: SELECT StoryId FROM dbo.StoryTag WHERE TagId = #{tagId}
